mostWorthwhile.text: Seeing the helped B cells multiply into antibody-making and memory cells made the two goals connect to one response.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the new cells only gave a list of partners, so it felt less engaging than seeing what the cells actually did, even though the hint was useful.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the B cell displayed a bacterial fragment too, after binding the intact protein.

arbitrary.text: The lymph node requirement for the helper T cell interaction was not obvious to me until the compatibility feedback showed it, although the messenger had traveled there.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: following the matching cells through to antibodies and memory made me curious about how the body responds in other situations.
